company_introduction.cash_flow_equation: OCF = Net profit + D&A - ΔWorking Capital (focus on receivables, inventory, contract liabilities). FCF = OCF - Capex. Working capital sensitive to dealer stocking, seasonal build, and customer advances.
company_introduction.capital_intensity_and_reinvestment: Moderate capex: tooling/molds for new models, assembly line expansion, headquarters construction. R&D spending for next-generation platforms. Cash also used for strategic equity investments and partnerships.

competition_and_moat.competition_and_substitution_analysis: In two-wheelers, the main threat is Yadea and Aima leveraging their massive scale to offer similar smart features at lower prices, compressing Ninebot's ASP premium. We estimate if premium gap narrows by 15%, revenue growth could slow to low single digits, cutting 2027E EPS by ~20%. In mowers, the substitutability risk comes from Husqvarna transitioning to wireless and offering an end-to-end solution with dealer network advantage. However, Ninebot's product is already 2-3 years ahead in user experience; the key is whether they can hold the tech lead. In scooters, the risk is low but omnipresent. New entrants like DJI could enter mobile robotics leveraging their vision tech, posing a credible threat by 2028.
claimed_mechanisms: Brand and heritage (Segway label for global recognition, trusted for personal mobility)
Technology/R&D: smart battery management, IoT connectivity, autonomous navigation for mowers
Global distribution network and local subsidiaries in US, Europe, Asia
Scale in procurement and manufacturing across multiple product lines
